sources.jevbench: hf://guychuk/pcdm-runs/jev_native_ts1c/summary.json — not mirrored into the local runs/ directory, which is partial. Its accuracies coincide with ts1c_tap17's standard and ts1b's hard to seven digits, but its Brier and ECE differ from both (hard Brier .7220 vs ts1b's .7909), so it is an independent run that ties, not a copy. The run-to-checkpoint mapping is inferred from the jev_native_<name> convention, not recorded in the summary.
sources.latency: buffalo:RESULTS.md#6-single-decision-latency (Qwen3-1.7B row, labelled "ts1b-shape recipe") = REPORT.md#3ab apples-to-apples. 1.7B apples-to-apples ladder row (REPORT #3ab, one pod, one torch build). It is a recipe-shape row, not a checkpoint row: ts1c is the same Qwen3-1.7B-Base backbone, same tap 20, same 512x2x8 tower as ts1b, so the shape row still describes it. ts1c's own bench (runs/bench_ts1c/bench.json) reads 60.6 ms at K=2 on a different pod/harness and is not comparable to the other rows in this file.
sources.external: MISSING -- no full-file eval_wf pass (max_state 4096, limit 0) exists for ts1c. runs/ts1c/eval_wf.json absent. runs/ts1c/results.json has these sets but at the capped training-pass protocol (eval_cap 1500, max_state 2048), which on ts1b/tm1b disagrees with the full pass by up to 34 points on pagerduty_trigger and flips sign across taps -- not the protocol the published .817/.838 figures use.

latency.note: MISSING -- tm2's in-process latency was never benchmarked (buffalo:RESULTS.md#6, Qwen3.5-4B row is all dashes; no runs/bench_tm2/). The 56/56/118 ms previously here is the Qwen3-4B apples-to-apples row and does not describe a Qwen3.5 hybrid Gated-DeltaNet stack (REPORT.md#3ag measures Qwen3.5-4B at 42-53 -> 34-46 ms on the serving path vs 26-27 -> 19-21 ms for Qwen3-4B). tm2's serving-path warm p50 is 33.7 ms at K=2 / 44.4 ms at K=32, L_s=256 (runs/serve_bench2/results.json, model "tm2") -- a different harness from the in-process ladder the other rows use, so it is not substituted here.
